external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues who sign in through the identity broker and use applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
external_entities.notes: The description does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who authenticate through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
external_entities.notes: The description does not state which franchise colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system from which colleague group membership and leaver changes are pulled overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider belonging to franchise colleagues that vouches for their identities.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates federated sign-ins, pulls directory changes, signs tokens, and writes sign-ins to the audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The description does not state the broker's interface kind, exposure, second-factor behavior, or encryption for its associated stores.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses broker-issued tokens and lets holders with the store-manager group change prices and void transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: The description does not state whether the key store is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Group membership is updated from the HR system overnight. The description does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The description does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: vouch
data_flows.description: Franchise colleagues present themselves to their own identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The description does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: administer store
data_flows.description: A colleague presents a token to the store admin console to change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.notes: A store-manager token works against every store because the console does not check store membership.
data_flows.data_description: token, price changes, and transaction voids

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps the signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with colleague and group changes pulled from the HR system.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The same overnight pull is how leavers stop being colleagues.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls colleague and group membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The description does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: colleague home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home from which they sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise identity provider
trust_boundaries.description: The boundary controlled by the franchise identity provider's party.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's contents are confidential because it holds a token signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's contents are confidential because it holds colleagues and their group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory holds colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's contents are confidential because it holds sign-in records associated with colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
